content.description:
Cardabbean is a virtual Caribbean style metaverse built on the Cardano blockchain where you can purchase your own private island in the Cardabbean Islands. In these private islands you can do anything... no laws, no politics, no religion and no fiat. Just your custom avatar hanging on your own private island.

Build residences, conduct business, deploy games, teleport between islands and much more!
